name: Office Harasser
source:
MC is the owner of a renowned company where three beautiful girls work:
Tess, Tanya and Allison, each with their own problems and personalities....
But it's not all sunshine and roses; a big deal to be consolidated will require your attention and cunning.
Will you be able to bribe the three beautiful employees and seal the contract?
Follow the story and make your own choices to find out!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2017010/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
MC是一家知名公司的老板，公司里有三个漂亮的女孩：
苔丝、坦尼娅和艾莉森，每个人都有自己的问题和性格……
但这并不全是阳光和玫瑰；一件大事需要你的关注和狡猾来巩固。
你能贿赂三位漂亮员工并签订合同吗？
跟随故事并做出自己的选择来找出答案！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2017010/]Steam[/url]]
